# Chapter 13: the editor as a debugger.
# The first picture needs the program publishing its journal: start it
# before, from the root of the project: build/examples/Debugger 120 &
doc/pics/13-Debugger.png -w -d 6 -f Journal -c tcp://localhost:5556 examples/Runtime/PickAndPlace/PickAndPlace.json
# The journal of a simulation of the editor.
doc/pics/13-Journal.png -w -r -d 6 -f Journal examples/Timed-Petri-Nets/Timeout/Timeout.json
# The editor following the C++ code generated for the German traffic lights,
# built with -DGRAFCET_DEBUG -lzmq and running (chapter 13, section 6).
doc/pics/13-GrafcetDebug.png -w -d 5 -f Journal -c tcp://localhost:5556 examples/GRAFCET/GermanTrafficLights/GermanTrafficLights.json
